name: trace.run
description: The replay header of one run: initial state and fault schedule, with the run's cartridge, source revision and seed; its trace.command entries follow by ordinal (09 §2; 11 §15). Producers: as trace.command.

name: trace.command
description: One game-trace entry per command: decision, delta digest, RNG draws, commit outcome, committed events and effect ids (11 §15; 09 §7). Producers: loka play and the simulator (R5), the local authority (R6).

name: content.diagnostic
description: One structured diagnostic (08 §6; cartridge.schema.json Diagnostic) with the digest of the input it is about. Producers: the TypeScript cartridge loader through loka play (R5 S1), and mix loka.compile from the slice that first stores its diagnostics.

name: simulation.invariant_failed
description: A registered invariant failed after a command; the ids are the deterministic repro (09 §2; roadmap verification harness). Producer: the deterministic simulator (R5), later fault simulation (R6).

name: kernel.decision_latency
description: Kernel decision latency of one command, in microseconds, on one host (11 §13 Runtime). Producers: loka play and the simulator on Node (R5), the local authority on Hermes (R6, R6P phone timing).

name: agent.work
description: One agent's model, tokens and its pull request's disposition (ADR-075 §8; the roadmap re-estimates). Producer: the PM, appending to docs/dev-evidence.jsonl when a pull request merges or closes.
